title: Hippocampal processed-population trace forecasting
target: Population trace mean over native frames t+31 through t+60
independent_unit: Animal suffix across all days,contexts and sessions
scope: Retained author-processed calcium traces only; amplitude normalization/calcium-event interpretation is not documented in the archive. No spikes,absolute calcium concentration or real-time physiology claim. Twenty-eight source animals; held animals stay within the same study.
timing: Every30 native frames after300-frame history, forecast next30-frame population mean ending60 frames later. Only trace frames<=t are inputs. Native frame index is used without inferring seconds or behavior alignment.
calibration: Past observed trace history is allowed. No held future calibration or source fitted maps/pvpreS/pvpostS enter features. All model parameters and flexible transforms are fitted on development animals.
